items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Because I used to play piano with Pirol privately in different places, you know.

ctx.x: Oh, I never knew about that. I know you've never knew about that. Freddie Ratlin wrote a song. What is this world to me? You see, what is this world to me? And he wrote the words. And he told Pirol, can you put that to me over? So Pirol composed an area up there. And Pirol came to me and said, you think you could do that? Because I used to play piano with Pirol privately in different places, you know. He used to play piano before he met Williams, before he met George Williams. And I wrote it in a compliment. You…
Past the 28 years, 56 years. You didn't renew it, I guess.
